page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan. Left page: blank, with only faint show-through from the reverse and a handwritten number in pencil. Right page: a title page, cropped at the right edge, so only the left parts of its lines are visible.
page.notes: The left page is blank. The faint lines across it (for example "CATECHISMI" and "Ecclesiae") are show-through from the reverse and are not transcribed. The handwritten "1996:01" is a library mark and is left out. The right page is cut off at the right edge, so the lines above show only their visible left parts. The large italic opening "Fo" is probably the start of a longer word and is uncertain. The small-capital fragments are uncertain because the edge cuts them off.
